data.standardized_narrative: This is the syndicate's first year of trading so there were no opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2018. During 2018 the syndicate built gross claims outstanding of $67.73m (year-end balance) largely reflecting a number of large natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and Californian wildfires) on its quota-share Property Treaty reinsurance. There is no prior-year reserve movement because there were no prior year reserves to re-evaluate.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2018 results reflect a number of large natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and Californian wildfires.
As a mono-line Property Treaty reinsurer writing US and International catastrophe business significant result volatility is expected.
The large losses noted above have hit the 2018 year and will therefore impact significantly the result on closure.
Adjustments arising in the current year for the revision to the prior year estimate of the provision for claims outstanding is disclosed in note 6.
